author: THSV StreamBridge
description: Lets chat trigger Streamfog face lenses on your camera with commands or channel point rewards, one lens at a time with cooldowns and a short queue.
changelog: 4.0.27: new Face Filters extension for Streamfog lenses through Streamer.bot.

manifest.name: Face Filters

actionsProvided.name: THSV Extension - Face Filters - Activate Lens

installationSteps: Install Streamfog, sign in, and connect it in Streamer.bot under Integrations > StreamFog (Remote Key, Auto Connect, Auto Reconnect).
In OBS, set your face-camera source to the Streamfog virtual camera instead of the physical camera.
Import the Face Filters Streamer.bot package, approve only Activate Lens in the wizard, and leave it triggerless.
List each lens as: Label | exact Streamfog lens name | !command | channel point reward title | seconds. Leave a column empty to skip it.
Enable the extension, restart StreamBridge, and use the wizard test to confirm one lens appears on camera.
uninstallationSteps: Disable the extension. Streamfog ends any active lens when its duration runs out.

healthChecks.description: Confirms bounded lens parsing, cooldowns, a single serialized lens queue, and approved Streamfog dispatch.
